§5.1 시범 시나리오 3 사건 오프라인 패키지 사전 적재
architecture: §4.1 Web 상황판 역할: 오프라인 패키지 적재 미완료 경고 배지
context_refs.boundaries: spec/boundaries.md §3 S7, §4.4 Event Catalog, §7 API Index, §9.2 Board Shell Slots

included: tileserver-gl container route and local MapLibre style
사건 메타, 실종자 도메인 데이터, OP, 담당 구역, 초기 마커, 지도 기준 범위, 지도 타일을 포함하는 단일 패키지 계약
overall_search_area 변경에 따른 manifest revision 증가와 stale package 표시
사건 종료/purge 시 package manifest/status 및 로컬 패키지 파기 hook

excluded.item: 현장 마커 작성, 사진 업로드, 알림 payload 계산
excluded.reason: S7은 초기 마커 read model만 manifest에 포함한다.

excluded.item: 지도 기준 범위와 수색 구역 geometry write
excluded.reason: S7은 SearchAreaQuery와 assigned area query 결과를 소비해 tile coverage와 package payload를 만든다.

excluded.item: OP 생성, OP assignment write, 인수인계 메모
excluded.reason: S7은 current/list OP와 assignment read contract만 소비한다.
S7 package installation는 입력 source이며 로컬 경고 UI와 retry scheduler는 S6 소유다.
S7은 OfflinePackageInstallationQuery와 이벤트를 제공하고 S3-2가 package_badge slot에 표시한다.

fr_mapping.summary: 오프라인 지도 표시를 위해 사전 다운로드된 영역에서 지도 타일을 사용할 수 있다.
fr_mapping.handling: 자체 tileserver-gl endpoint와 manifest tile set을 통해 Android/Web MapLibre가 같은 OSM/OpenMapTiles 기반 타일을 사용한다.

fr_mapping.summary: 사건 화면에서 실종자 기본 정보를 오프라인에서도 확인할 수 있게 한다.
fr_mapping.handling: manifest는 missing person data와 사진 참조를 포함해 사건 배정 단말의 오프라인 사건 화면에서 조회 가능하게 한다. tile/style endpoint는 FR-19/FR-31 구현 계약으로 다룬다.
S7은 package installation와 manifest item status를 제공하고 S6 LocalWarningMonitor가 앱 경고로 표시한다.

패키지는 타일 단독이 아니라 incident metadata, missing person data, OP, assigned areas, initial markers, overall_search_area, tile references를 포함하며, overall_search_area revision 변경 시 offline_package_installation를 STALE로 수렴시키고 재다운로드 대상을 분리한다.

consumed.usage: manifest incident metadata와 missing person data 포함, closed incident package write 차단.
manifest app fetch와 status write의 policePhone authorization, policePhone별 status key.
tile coverage, overall_search_area package item, assigned areas package item 생성.
offline_package_installation commit 후 S7이 PublishRequest.OFFLINE_PACKAGE_INSTALLATION_CHANGED를 생성해 EventHub.publish(PublishRequest...)를 호출한다. event_dispatch_job row 적재와 fanout은 S4 소유다.
초기 기준 마커와 seed/reference markers를 manifest에 포함.
Android status write는 Outbox/idempotency 경유로 전송.
OP 목록, current OP, 담당 구역 assignment를 manifest에 포함.

events_published.trigger: offline_package_installation row commit after app status report or manifest revision staleness update

events_subscribed.handler: manifest revision을 증가시키고 기존 READY/PARTIAL status를 STALE로 표시한다.
assigned area package item 후보를 최신화한다.
current OP package item을 최신화하고 필요 시 manifest revision을 증가시킨다.
PolicePhone/team별 assigned area item을 최신화하고 status 재적재 필요 여부를 계산한다.
신규 manifest/status write를 차단하고 local package purge 대상 상태를 제공한다.
offline_package_manifest/status purge hook 완료 후 remaining package read를 차단한다.

acceptance_criteria.when: assigned app PolicePhone requests offline package manifest
acceptance_criteria.then: manifest includes incident metadata, missing person data, OP, assigned areas when present, initial markers, overall_search_area, and tileItems in one package contract

acceptance_criteria.given: local police patrol car account has no assigned area yet
acceptance_criteria.then: manifest still includes OP1, overall_search_area, initial markers, PolicePhone identity context, and tileItems so patrol/foot search can start

acceptance_criteria.given: package download partially fails on tile and marker items
acceptance_criteria.then: status remains not ready for offline use, failed item keys are preserved, and OFFLINE_PACKAGE_INSTALLATION_CHANGED is published

acceptance_criteria.given: PolicePhone has READY package for manifest revision 3
acceptance_criteria.then: old PolicePhone status becomes STALE and S3-2 package_badge can show re-download required

acceptance_criteria.then: responses are served from local tileserver-gl route and style metadata includes OpenStreetMap attribution

acceptance_criteria.then: validation fails because external tile hosts are forbidden

acceptance_criteria.given: manifest expires before status report completes
acceptance_criteria.when: PolicePhone posts READY for expired manifest
acceptance_criteria.then: API rejects with write_conflict and app must not show READY/offline-use-ready state

acceptance_criteria.when: request is authorized as web user
acceptance_criteria.then: API returns 403 channel_not_allowed and no status/event row is written

acceptance_criteria.given: unregistered or unassigned PolicePhone requests manifest or posts status
acceptance_criteria.then: API returns police_phone_not_registered or police_phone_not_assigned and no local ready state is created

acceptance_criteria.when: PolicePhone posts package installation or requests new manifest
acceptance_criteria.then: write is rejected with incident_closed or read returns sanitized unavailable state, and PackagePurgeHook marks local package purge target

acceptance_criteria.given: SC-09 package installation write is replayed through S6 Outbox and S7 commits offline_package_installation
acceptance_criteria.when: S7 publishes OFFLINE_PACKAGE_INSTALLATION_CHANGED and S3-2 package_badge API assembly consumes it
acceptance_criteria.then: owner response, S4 event probe, OfflinePackageInstallationQuery.byIncident, and S3-2 package_badge probe converge on the same id/status/version/manifestVersion from harness_fixtures.sc09_package_status_convergence

acceptance_criteria.given: SC-03 manifest download is running or SC-09 package installation replay is waiting for S6 Outbox

edge_cases: Manifest has no assignedAreas because 초동 순찰차 수색 starts before area split
Overall search area exists but tile coverage calculation exceeds harness maximum tile count
Tile server is reachable for style JSON but a subset of pbf tiles returns 404/503
PolicePhone retries status with same Idempotency-Key and identical body
PolicePhone retries status with same Idempotency-Key but different body
OP_TRANSITIONED occurs while package download is in progress
INCIDENT_CLOSED arrives while PolicePhone is offline with partially downloaded package
OSM attribution is missing from style metadata
Style JSON includes external tile URL

error_handling.tile_unavailable: Manifest fetch or tile/style endpoint returns 503; app keeps completed items and allows failed item retry.
error_handling.write_conflict: Reject READY/PARTIAL status for old or expired manifest and require manifest refresh before package can be marked READY.
error_handling.overall_search_area_required: Manifest fetch fails until S2 provides active overall_search_area; app shows package unavailable instead of tile-only 대체 표시.
error_handling.police_phone_not_registered: Reject manifest/status request and prevent local package save.
error_handling.police_phone_not_assigned: Reject manifest/status request and show authorization failure distinct from retryable network failure.
error_handling.channel_not_allowed: Reject web status writes; web may only read package installation through S3-2 package_badge path.
error_handling.incident_closed: Reject new status writes and expose purge-required local package state.
error_handling.idempotency_mismatch: Return 409 and keep previous status response cached; do not publish a second event.

performance: Manifest generation should use cached tile coverage per incident/overall_search_area revision where possible.
Status write should publish OFFLINE_PACKAGE_INSTALLATION_CHANGED within the common event convergence target.
Tile endpoints must support repeated Android retry without changing package item checksum.
security: Manifest and tile/style endpoints require authenticated APP or WEB channel in harness.
App manifest/status access requires registered and assigned PolicePhone.
Manifest must not include internal incident_data_purge, location_data_access_audit, event_dispatch_job, or marker_notification details.
Closed incident manifest must not expose missing person PII or package re-download links.
observability: Expose manifest generation count and latency by incidentId/revision.
Expose package installation counts by status and incident.
Expose tile_unavailable count by style/z/x/y and tileserver health.
licensing: OSM attribution must be present in style JSON metadata and visible to MapLibre consumers.
No external tile hosts are allowed in harness style sources.
